defects.title: registration ownership discovered by name pattern, not by gitdir
defects.root_cause: scan_worktrees iterated `$SHOKUNIN_ROOT` and `$SHOKUNIN_ROOT/*-shokunin`. Any owner repo whose directory name lacks the `-shokunin` suffix was never scanned, so its linked-worktree registrations were absent from WT_MAP. The target then fell through to the artifact engine, matched a stale receipt and was DELETED.
defects.fresh_repro: /var/tmp/cand-f1-repro-r9-s11.sh case W20 against the installed tools
defects.repro_before: verify=SAFE(stale) `scratch-type=scratch-dir refs=0 mtime-age-days=3`; quarantine RESULT DELETED rc=0; the dirty worktree with its private unpushed branch and live active.txt was removed
defects.repro_after: verify=NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch) `branch=private unpushed=1 dir=present owner=owner`; quarantine NOT-AUTHORIZED rc=3; active.txt intact, no .ufo-quarantine dir created
defects.fix: scan_worktrees now iterates `$SHOKUNIN_ROOT/*`, resolves each candidate root's gitdir, and skips linked worktrees (gitdir under */worktrees/*). Ownership is therefore structural, not name-based.

defects.title: duplicate registration resolved last-writer-wins
defects.root_cause: WT_MAP keyed only by canonical path, so when two registrations named the same target the second overwrote the first. A later pushed registration masked an earlier unpushed one, producing a false SAFE(metadata-prune).
defects.repro_before: verify=SAFE(metadata-prune) `dir=absent unique=0 head=40dfc8491be6 owner=owner-shokunin`; quarantine SKIPPED rc=0. Removing the shadowing registration then revealed NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch).
defects.repro_after: verify=NOT-SAFE(registration-conflict) `multiple registrations disagree (branch=private unpushed=1 dir=absent owner=owner-shokunin)`; quarantine DRY-RUN-BLOCKED rc=3
defects.fix: _wt_record appends every claimant (newline-separated) instead of overwriting; evaluate_worktree evaluates all claimants and fails closed with receipt `registration-conflict` when a SAFE and a NOT-SAFE claimant coexist.

defects.title: gitfile repository root misclassified as an ordinary artifact
defects.root_cause: evaluate_path gated evaluate_repo_root behind `[ -d "$target/.git" ]`. A root created with --separate-git-dir carries a `.git` FILE, so the test failed and the root fell through to the artifact engine, which granted a false SAFE(pushed).
defects.fresh_repro: fresh /var/tmp fixture: `git init --separate-git-dir=<admin>` root with a pushed origin ref
defects.repro_before: verify=SAFE(pushed) `intro=43c5d5970eda ref=refs/remotes/origin/main ancestor=yes` (installed tool); vault VERIFIED(pushed)
defects.repro_after: verify=NOT-SAFE(none) `unpushed=0 dirty=0`; vault NOT-VERIFIED(none); quarantine DRY-RUN-BLOCKED rc=3
defects.fix: new repo_gitdir()/is_repo_root() helpers resolve a `.git` file's `gitdir:` pointer and reject linked-worktree gitdirs; evaluate_path and the quarantine preflight both use them.

defects.title: worktree uniqueness excludes the candidate through its own linked-worktree HEAD
defects.root_cause: `git log --oneline <head> --not --all` counts the registration's own HEAD as a reference to the candidate, so a commit reachable only through the registration under evaluation reported unique=0 and earned a false SAFE(metadata-prune).
defects.repro_before: verify=SAFE(metadata-prune) `dir=absent unique=0 head=c4ace32e36fe`; quarantine SKIPPED rc=0
defects.repro_after: verify=NOT-SAFE(none) `dir=absent unique=1 head=c4ace32e36fe`; quarantine DRY-RUN-BLOCKED rc=3
defects.fix: the uniqueness query now uses `--not --branches --remotes --tags`, which ignores every worktree HEAD. `--not refs/heads refs/remotes refs/tags` was tested first and rejected: git fatals with 'ambiguous argument'.
